name: rgb_proxy
source: this repository (S1): three rectangular wavelength windows standing in for the engine's sRGB / Rec.709 channels, a DECLARED proxy with no spectral rendering behind it; the windows are the conventional blue / green / red thirds of the visible range, not a measured camera response
not_claimed: no spectral rendering: the engine shades three sRGB / Rec.709 channels and nothing in this file changes that
no BRDF spectra and no camera quantum efficiency: the windows are declared, not measured

the band radiance L_e = L_v / (683 K_band) is a photometric proxy converted through the STATED illuminant (ASTM G173-03 direct) and CIE 1924 V(lambda); a scene lit by another spectrum is not represented
the identity weights reproduce the frame (the null test); any other weights are a stated mixing, not a calibration
